emblems.name: Grass-Stuffed Knuckle
emblems.flavor: Popped off its fist joint with a twist, still packed with dirt from the last thing it punched.

emblems.name: Twitching Hock
emblems.flavor: A hind leg joint that kept kicking in your hand a full minute after the rest of it stopped.

emblems.name: The Good Eye
emblems.flavor: Pried out whole, wide open, crusted with pollen and aimed at absolutely nothing.

emblems.name: Voicebox on a Reed
emblems.flavor: Bitten out of its neck; it made no noise going in and none coming out.

emblems.name: Both Shoulder Plates
emblems.flavor: You took one off each side so nobody could argue about which one was weaker.

emblems.name: Leech-Bitten Fistbone
emblems.flavor: A knuckle bone the marsh leeches had already claimed before you got your teeth in.

emblems.name: Splayed Marsh Foot
emblems.flavor: Cut off at the ankle with mud still packed between the toes it used to skim on.

emblems.name: Pickled Sighting Eye
emblems.flavor: Plucked from the socket and dropped in swamp water, where it looks no worse than it did alive.

emblems.name: Hollow Fang Sleeve
emblems.flavor: One drained tooth; the venom sac went down your throat before you thought to keep it.

emblems.name: Flank-to-Flank Hide Strip
emblems.flavor: Sawn straight across its back, so the strip has no weak side either.

emblems.name: Crag-Chipped Knuckle
emblems.flavor: Its biggest fist bone, chipped all over from punching rock it could actually beat.

emblems.name: Ledge-Gripping Claw
emblems.flavor: Snapped off the stone it died holding, with a curl of grit still under the hook.

emblems.name: Frost-Clouded Eye
emblems.flavor: Froze solid before you finished chewing the rest, and it is still pointed downhill.

emblems.name: Peeled Throat Skin
emblems.flavor: A strip off the neck, thin as breath and just as quiet, dried stiff by the wind.

emblems.name: Brow Ridge, Sawn Flat
emblems.flavor: Took three tries to get off the skull because it argued the whole way through.

emblems.name: Salt-Crusted Fist
emblems.flavor: One huge knuckle gone white with dried spray, sand still jammed under the nails.

emblems.name: Sprint Tendon
emblems.flavor: Pulled out of the leg; it snapped like wet rope and left tracks nobody bothered following.

emblems.name: Sand-Scoured Eye Ring
emblems.flavor: The bony ring out of its face, rubbed smooth by shore wind long before you ate the middle.

emblems.name: Gullet Pouch
emblems.flavor: Cut from under the jaw and smells of nothing at all, which is exactly how it hunted you.

emblems.name: Barnacled Spine Plate
emblems.flavor: Pried off its back with the shellfish still alive and gripping the underside.

emblems.name: Scorched Knucklebone
emblems.flavor: Cracked black outside, greasy white inside, and still warm when you pocket it.

emblems.name: Cinder-Burnt Footpad
emblems.flavor: You took the whole pad; the soles were cooked through before you ever caught up to it.

emblems.name: Glassed Eye
emblems.flavor: The ash melted hard around it, and the eye keeps staring out through the glass.

emblems.name: Smoke-Cured Fang
emblems.flavor: One tooth out of a mouth that never once made a sound, tastes of soot and old meat.

emblems.name: Ring of Slag Scutes
emblems.flavor: A hacked-off collar of back plates, heavy and identical on every single side.
